value.rationale: A complete sharp minimal-order theorem explains the first tree network where the optimal one-sentinel intervention has two independent transmissibility-induced changes. It combines full small-tree impossibility, a concrete 9-vertex witness, exact crossover algebra, and a self-contained certificate. The exact small-network boundary is a natural qualitative structural threshold; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a mere numerical instance.
